title: Proceed to final submission from review and reach the locked receipt
description: This test verifies that a candidate can review the exam, confirm irreversible submission, and land on the locked post-submission receipt.

steps.description: Navigate to /exam
Open the review dashboard
Confirm the final submission
Verify the post-submission receipt is displayed and the session is locked

title: Confirm final submission from the review dashboard
description: This test verifies that the review dashboard can complete the irreversible submission flow and move the user to the locked post-submission screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the review dashboard
Click the submission proceed action
Click the confirm final submission action
Verify the locked post-submission screen is displayed
Verify a submission receipt is displayed

title: Answer a question and advance with autosave
description: This test verifies that selecting an answer and using Save & Next advances to the next question while preserving the response.

steps.description: Navigate to /exam
Select an answer for the current question
Save the response and move to the next question
Verify the next question is displayed and the saved answer is retained

title: Complete candidate login with offline verification
description: This test verifies that a student can enter valid identity details, pass offline verification, and reach the instructions waiting page.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the University Seat Number field with a valid 10-digit value
Fill in the date of birth field with a valid date
Submit the login form
Verify offline verification succeeds and the instructions waiting page is displayed

title: Start the exam after release and consent
description: This test verifies that a candidate can use the release option, accept consent, and start the timed exam from the instructions page.

steps.description: Navigate to /instructions
Use the release paper now control
Accept the consent requirement
Start the examination
Verify the exam workspace is displayed

title: Review the locked completion receipt
description: This test verifies that the post-submission screen shows the locked completion state with an audit receipt and verified response ledger.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the post-submission screen
Verify the locked completion state is displayed
Verify an audit receipt and verified response ledger are displayed

title: Inspect the review dashboard summary
description: This test verifies that the review dashboard shows the reconciliation summary needed before final submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the review dashboard
Verify answered, unanswered, and marked-for-review tallies are displayed
Verify the submission summary overview is displayed

title: Read candidate details and wait for release on instructions page
description: This test verifies that the instructions page shows candidate identity details and only allows starting after consent and release conditions are satisfied.

steps.description: Navigate to /instructions
Verify the candidate identity card is displayed
Verify the countdown or release state is displayed
Verify the instructions waiting page presents the required exam-start gating information

title: Cancel final submission and return to the exam
description: This test verifies that a user can open the irreversible submission confirmation and cancel back to the exam workspace without submitting.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the review dashboard
Click the submission proceed action
Click the cancel action in the confirmation modal
Verify the exam workspace is displayed

title: Switch to the exam workspace from the dock
description: This test verifies that the persistent screen switcher can take a tester directly to the exam workspace for UI verification.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the exam workspace
Verify the exam workspace is displayed

title: Enter the review dashboard through emergency final submit
description: This test verifies that the emergency final submit path takes the candidate from the exam workspace to the review dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /exam
Click the emergency final submit control
Verify the review dashboard is displayed

title: Block login until identity details are complete
description: This test verifies that incomplete or invalid identity details prevent login and keep the candidate on the login screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the University Seat Number field with fewer than 10 characters
Fill in the date of birth field with an incomplete value
Submit the login form
Verify validation feedback is shown and login remains blocked on the login screen

title: Reset the demo session from the dock
description: This test verifies that the persistent screen switcher can reset the current session and return the app to the login screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock reset action
Verify the login screen is displayed

title: Remain locked after attempting restricted navigation
description: This test verifies that the post-submission kiosk remains locked when a user attempts restricted browser navigation actions.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the post-submission screen
Press the browser refresh shortcut
Press the browser back shortcut
Verify the locked completion state is still displayed

title: Mark a question for review and jump from the question matrix
description: This test verifies that a candidate can mark a question for review and use the question matrix to jump directly to another question.

steps.description: Navigate to /exam
Mark the current question for review
Open the question matrix
Select a different question number from the matrix
Verify the selected question opens and the review status is preserved

title: Log a visibility change incident during the exam
description: This test verifies that the exam records a security incident when the page loses visibility and returns without losing progress.

steps.description: Navigate to /exam
Trigger a visibility change away from the exam window
Return focus to the exam
Verify a security incident notice is displayed and the exam state is preserved

title: Verify the exam matrix is reachable from the review flow
description: This test verifies that the review dashboard can return the user directly to the exam matrix for continued editing.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the review dashboard
Click the jump to matrix action
Verify the exam matrix is displayed

title: Jump directly to the post-submission view from the dock
description: This test verifies that the stitch screen switcher can open the final locked view directly for design verification without completing the exam flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the post-submission screen
Verify the post-submission view is displayed
Verify the submission lock state is displayed

title: Open invigilator assistance from login
description: This test verifies that a candidate can request invigilator help from the login screen and see the assistance confirmation state.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Click the invigilator assistance control
Confirm the assistance request
Verify an assistance confirmation is displayed for the assigned terminal

title: Inspect the login screen from the dock
description: This test verifies that the persistent dock can bring a tester back to the login view for starting a candidate session.

steps.description: Navigate to /app
Click the dock option for the login screen
Verify the login screen is displayed

title: Prevent exam start before countdown ends
description: This test verifies that the exam cannot be started while the release countdown is still active, even after consent is accepted.

steps.description: Navigate to /instructions
Accept the consent requirement
Attempt to start the examination before release
Verify the start action is blocked and the instructions page remains visible

title: Keep the first question stable when Previous is unavailable
description: This test verifies that the Previous control is unavailable on the first question and the candidate remains on Question 1.

steps.description: Navigate to /exam
Verify the Previous control is disabled on the first question and Question 1 remains displayed
